description: A `return` in an arm of a match used as a call ARGUMENT is refused (E-CG-003) even when the arm also contains a lambda — only the lambda's own body is exempt (S462 review F5).
rationale: Through the value IIFE an arm's `return` would leave only the arm and silently become the match's value; the refusal must not be defeated by an unrelated `=>` in the same arm.
